verdict.rationale: Belvo documents several product-run background automations. Smart Collections lets you set amounts and balance conditions, then watches the account in the background. Recurrent links refresh data weekly on a recurring schedule and notify via webhook, and Smart Transfers automate recurring Pix payments. These are fixed, domain-specific automations rather than a general facility for users or AI agents to define their own autonomous workflows. missing for 10: user-definable general-purpose automation or scheduling, configurable schedules beyond the fixed weekly refresh, agent-driven autonomous task execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: you tell Belvo the amounts you want to collect as well as the balance conditions to wait for and Belvo watches the account in the background
With recurrent links, Belvo automatically refreshes information weekly and notifies you via webhook so you always have up-to-date data.
Smart Transfers — Automate recurring payments with Pix
Automate balance-based Pix collections. Belvo monitors your user's balance and notifies you the moment there are enough funds to collect.
